note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation and cross-checked by Exophase and PSNProfiles (they agree on all 55). Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry; each one names the published guides its facts come from. Methods no published guide has confirmed yet are marked unconfirmed instead of invented.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the payoff, not a task: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. Follow the roadmap below — story first, then the 100% checklist, then the leftovers — and the dashboard at the top shows exactly what is still standing between you and it. PowerPyx rates the whole hunt 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first thing the game asks of you. It pops when the mission ends, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Story trophies pop as you play; the only real job is to save manually at the start and end of the chapter, because missions cannot be replayed (PowerPyx). Do the balcony meditation in this chapter — see Positive Mental Attitude — before you leave it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. The story runs 60–80 hours across five chapters (PowerPyx), so settle in — every chapter trophy pops on its own as you play. The last meditation spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in this chapter (GTASpotter).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. Keep scanning vehicles and places with the WAiNK app as you travel (KeenGamer) — the counts for Whip It Good and You WAiNKer! climb during the story instead of becoming a post-game chore.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. By now the side content is piling up — stranger strands, races, robberies — and all of it counts toward the 100% checklist, so do what is in front of you instead of leaving it all for after the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.riskNote: No mission replay — save manually before the final mission. Free roam continues after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission in Chapter 5. Save manually before you start it: there is no mission replay (PowerPyx), so a save is your only way back. Once it pops, free roam continues and the 100% Completion Checklist unlocks (PushSquare) — the real clean-up starts here.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run when the story offers it. Mission trophies pop on completion — just play the story in order and they come to you.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set-pieces — follow the plan the game lays out, keep your crew alive, and the trophy pops at the getaway.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play when the story offers it. Like every mission trophy, it pops on completion — no extra objective, no hidden step.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. It is a named story mission, so it arrives in the natural order of the plot — play the story through and it pops at the end of the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Airport missions tend to be loud — expect a wanted level on the way out and have a fast car ready for the escape.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the six named-mission trophies — once it pops, every story-mission trophy is behind you except the finale itself.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.riskNote: Blocked if Positive Mental Attitude is missed — the checklist needs every meditation spot.
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — the checklist only appears once the story is done (PowerPyx). It is lenient: roughly 60% of true completion, needing 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied (PowerPyx). It still demands every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest in full — so treat the checklist as the plan for Step 2 of the roadmap, not a separate grind.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. There are 397 stunts in Leonida and you need 250 of them (PushSquare). Stunts register as you drive, jump and slide through the world — chase the counter during normal play and mop up the rest after the story, when the checklist shows what is left.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once (KeenGamer). Sample everything early — fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest — and this pops long before you have finished any of them.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The medals are not brutally hard (PowerPyx) — learn one range's rhythm, then repeat it across the others. Ranges stay open after the story and count toward the 100% checklist, so there is no rush.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Every location also counts for the 100% checklist, which demands every drone race — so run them all during Step 2 of the roadmap and two trophies move at once.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Mix street, off-road and water races as you find them, and favour the fastest vehicle class for each event instead of forcing one favourite car everywhere.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the nine activity types — learn the reel timing on easy catches first, then take Cal on when you can land fish cleanly without snapping the line.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through — there is no score target, just completion, so this is a quick win between bigger jobs.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.riskNote: Andy's strand is Lucia-only — play it as Lucia. Quest givers return after the story, but finish it before the finale to be safe.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. His strand is Lucia-only (GTASpotter), so play it as Lucia while the story runs. Stranger quest-givers tied to trophies come back after the story (GTASpotter), but do the strand before the finale to be safe — and it counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through his strand as it appears on the map and finish it — it counts as one of the 8 strands for Strangers & Freaks, so the two trophies move together.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida — take each one when it appears instead of leaving all five final missions for the endgame.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Five of them end in the named final-mission trophies (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) — finish those five, then find three more strands in the world. Quest-givers tied to trophies come back after the story (GTASpotter), so this is a clean-up trophy, not a race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His strand is one of the five named stranger finales — finish it during the story or in the post-story clean-up, when every quest-giver tied to a trophy returns (GTASpotter).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.riskNote: Tyrone's strand is Jason-only — play it as Jason.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His strand is Jason-only (GTASpotter), so play it as Jason — the mirror of Andy's Lucia-only strand. Finish it before the finale to be safe.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.riskNote: THE only possibly missable trophy (PowerPyx, KeenGamer): the first meditation, at Jason's house balcony in Chapter 1, can only be done before leaving Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots — and do the first one in Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept (KeenGamer). That balcony session is the one the guides flag as possibly missable (PowerPyx). The last spot opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 (GTASpotter).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.riskNote: Bret's quests are Jason-only and every Bret quest is required for the 100% checklist — do them as Jason.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are Jason-only (GTASpotter), and every Bret quest is required for the 100% checklist (PowerPyx) — do them as Jason, track the animal patiently, and take the shot only when it is clean.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game (PushSquare) and 15 are needed for 100% completion — so collect far beyond this trophy; every set you finish now is checklist progress later.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan unfamiliar vehicles and places as you travel (KeenGamer) — scanning early means the counter climbs during the story instead of becoming a post-game chore.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in 8 groups of 10 (PowerPyx, via GTASpotter), and 100% completion needs 70 — so this trophy is a milestone on the way to 70, and you may skip the hardest 10 entirely.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape. Build the heat with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search cones until it cools off — hiding in the hills beats trying to outrun it.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route past three shops, keep the heat alive between stops, and do not let it drop to zero before the third till — a quiet stretch of road between shops is what kills the run.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app as you meet them (KeenGamer) — 100% completion needs 200 of 277 base models scanned (PowerPyx), so keep scanning past this trophy.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a tight group — a gang shootout or a robbery escape — trigger Combat Focus and chain the five before the meter runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport by an unofficial route. Any aircraft or runway exit that is not a scheduled flight counts; try it when the airport is quiet so the wanted level stays manageable.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — deal with the tanks. Rhinos roll in at high wanted levels; bring heavy weapons and cover, or steal one and turn it on its friends.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go at night, move slowly and stay out of the sightlines — one spotted guard ends the attempt, so case the store first and know where every camera and clerk is.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults are among the robberies the 100% checklist demands in full — eight bank vault robberies in all (KeenGamer) — so plan routes and getaway cars before you go in, and do not stop for a sixth vault until the heat is gone.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, crack it, grab the cash and break away before backup arrives — a fast car parked nearby is half the job.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas on the map. Drive every road and the counter fills in; check Progress to see which corners are still blank, and save the far islands and swamps for a dedicated sweep after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One per gang — keep a list of which gangs you have hit, and note that the 100% checklist wants 39 gang operations in all (KeenGamer), so the robbery habit pays twice.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy is the moment, not a mission, and it is there whenever you want it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a showroom car straight through the glass and out onto the street — the classic way out, and the wanted level that follows is part of the fun.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Bowl a full game — it also counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so do it early.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is all the public list gives — this is one to meet naturally as the story's partnership moments play out. No published guide has confirmed its trigger yet, and this guide will not invent one.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.riskNote: Choice-gated by its own description — save manually before big story decisions so a choice can be revisited.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The list gives no count and no trigger, so the honest advice is procedural: save manually before big story decisions, because the one thing the description does say is that choices are the point. The method is unconfirmed in the published guides.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.riskNote: Reads as a retry trophy — keep a manual save before tough story beats so a second try is always available.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No published guide confirms the trigger yet — the honest read is a retry: fail something, then succeed on the next attempt. Keep a manual save before tough story beats so a second try is always available.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method (KeenGamer) — it is tied to witnessing something strange in the world. Explore the odd corners of Leonida and the moment will find you; do not trust any guide that claims a fixed spot yet.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — the precise method is still being confirmed (KeenGamer), so try it on lone pedestrians on quiet roads and expect a wanted level.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — launder them steadily through contacts instead of hoarding them, and the total climbs on its own while you chase the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. It counts cumulatively — weapons, clothes, food, car mods — so just play and shop normally, and top it up with one big purchase at the end if you are short.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in all (KeenGamer). Buy them as they come on the market; garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so the two trophies share the same shopping trips.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any ten vehicles you own — register them as you collect them, and the trophy pops at the tenth. Your garages from Little Boxes are where they live.
